critical_code_review_comments: Iter 399 split is CLEAN: attendance_core (1,265) + attendance_admin_core (1,507) + payroll_core (744) — all now well under the 2k-line soft cap. shared/dates.py is the right pattern; the iter-398 concern about server.py-as-import-hub is partially addressed. Recommend continuing that migration by moving _onboarding_login_gate + _auto_close_open_shifts + _compute_payroll_run into shared modules so nothing needs to import from server.

server.py is still ~14k lines and remains an import hub (routes/payroll_core.py still does `from server import (...)` to grab db, get_user_from_token, require_role, now_iso, plus _compute_payroll_run at bottom re-export). Long-term, move common infra (auth deps + db handle) into shared/auth.py and shared/db.py so downstream routers stop reaching back into server.

/api/salary/monthly declares no `month` query param (payroll_core.py:47) but the problem statement mentioned '?month=2026-06'. The extra query is silently ignored (endpoint always returns last 6 months) — not a bug but worth aligning either the API doc or the caller. If per-month lookup is needed, add a `month: Optional[str] = None` param.

(8) There is no public DELETE /messages/{id} — use direct mongo cleanup for messages.
